_comment: Every source: running, configured but waiting, ideas, and sites ruled out. Ingest runs only status running. Only displayName is required; check here before probing a site. See the core's docs/sources.md (github.com/rhundhausen/weekend). The site hides a city with no upcoming events from its City list; that is presentation only, so keep every running source for such a city: it still runs nightly, and the city reappears once it has an event. doNotIngest lists companies and sites never to ingest, such as one that asked to be removed, matched by name, displayName, or site (see the schema); adding one stops it in one edit.

sources.name: kbco-calendar
sources.notes: Area: Boulder and Denver. iHeart station, found 2026-11-14 under station calendars. robots.txt allows /calendar/. The calendar lists about 60 upcoming concerts and community events (categories Community, Concerts, Entertainment, Holiday, Station Events), such as Foy Vance at the Fox Theatre and WinterFest at Chautauqua. List cards give title, date, and category; each event page (/calendar/content/<date>-<slug>/) adds the venue and times as text. No schema.org Event data and no feed. The Fox Theatre and Boulder Theater are only ideas here, so their shows would be new; most other venues are in Denver. iHeart's terms forbid scraping only for AI uses. Would need a new scrape mode. Configured 2026-11-14 with the new scrape mode iheart, which reads the calendar records in the page's __PRELOADED_STATE__ data (title, venue name and address, start times, categories) in one request, and keeps only events whose address is in a Boulder area city. Dry run: 9 of the 63 listed events, at the Fox Theatre, Boulder Theater, and Chautauqua; the Denver ones and station promotions with no address are dropped. Times matched the event pages.

Area: Denver metro. Bonneville country station, found 2026-11-14 under station calendars. The Events Calendar REST API works (tribe adapter).
